summary: Both bounded mechanisms from the locked design are implemented in src/awf/control/worker/cleanup.py and wired via mixins.py. (1) Inline bounded retry inside _teardown_terminal_auth_overlay (3 immediate no-sleep attempts, each failed attempt logged with reason_code, umount(8) stderr, and attempt index; success short-circuits to True, exhaustion returns False; None for no work dir preserved). (2) Deferred re-sweep: _record_terminal_runtime_released atomically adds a pending marker (attempt=1) in the same transaction as terminal_runtime_released when auth_overlay_unmounted is False; _retry_pending_terminal_auth_overlay_unmounts is piggybacked on the existing terminal-runtime-release scan with a guarded swallow-and-log call (CancelledError re-raised) that does not perturb release-error aggregation; per-candidate retry records resolved on success/None, appends incremented pending below the 5-sweep bound, or records a loud exhausted marker at the bound. New event types/reason codes flow end-to-end on both WorkspaceEvent and structured logs; candidate query uses dialect-safe event-type existence/count predicates only (no JSONB value comparison, no migration), with node scoping and repo_url skip mirroring _list_terminal_runtime_candidates. Tests cover all planned scenarios (test_cleanup_auth_overlay_retry.py: inline transient-then-success, persistent-exhaust, pending-marker write, resolved/exhausted/append-pending sweeps, candidate-query skip/exclude/limit, per-candidate failure routing, CancelledError propagation, record-helper dedup/skip), and the existing port-reclaim-not-blocked invariants in test_cleanup_branch_edges.py are preserved (recorded==[False], any(...) warning assertions intact) with the new async no-op added to the 4 release-resources workers. Scope respected: only cleanup.py, mixins.py wiring, and tests changed; bootstrap.py/auth_mounts.py/pre_push_validation.py/manager.py/config.py/DB models untouched. Catalog-coverage guard not required (reason_code, not error_code). Broad validation (ruff/mypy/pytest/coverage) is AWF/CI-owned per the plan and runs in the validation phase.
